title: Sign-in: the focused phone box has a red-orange ring that looks like an error, and the field and button don't match
where: /admin/login, signed out, AdminLoginClient, 1440x900, as it opens
what_happens: The phone box is autofocused, so the page opens with a red-orange border (the --ring colour, close to --destructive) before anything was typed. The box is 44px tall, the Send code button under it 32px. The code step's box uses a different style again (rounded-md, py-2; read from code, not seen: needs a sent SMS).
who_hurts: Someone signing in first sees what looks like an error on an empty field.
suggested_fix: Use the same field style on both steps and the matching Button size (size="lg" or h-11) in src/app/admin/login/login-client.tsx:93,104,113; if the red ring is unwanted, use a softer focus ring (ring/50 like the Button).
rule: established pattern: Button focus uses ring/50; consistency between the two sign-in steps
